# Shared test vectors of the sensor advertisements (rlcd_panel/switchbot_ble.h, bthome_ble.h, atc_ble.h, thermopro_ble.h).
# Read by the C++ host tests; the Android phone app (SensorAdvertisement.decode) reads the same file.
# The input is what the firmware gets from the BLE stack, so the hex strings use the same bytes:
#   mfg = Manufacturer Data with the 2-byte little-endian company ID first (the first byte of a ThermoPro frame is 0xC2),
#   svc_uuid = the 16-bit UUID of the first Service Data (hex), svc = the Service Data bytes after the UUID.
# Dispatch order of the firmware: BTHOME (0xFCD2), ATC (0x181A), ThermoPro (mfg byte 0 = 0xC2, 5 bytes or more), SwitchBot.
# Line: name | ble_mac | adv_name | mfg | svc_uuid | svc | format | mac | temp_c | rh_pct | battery_pct
# "-" is an empty field. Format "null" means that the packet is rejected (the output fields are then "-").
# Battery -1 means that the packet has no battery value. Temperature tolerance is 0.05 C.
